description: This PHP source file implements a command-line interface tool for installing the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines the 'CliInstall' class with methods to handle installation processes, including database setup, configuration file creation, and validation, based on command-line arguments. The script initiates the installation routine when executed.

classes.name: CliInstall
classes.description: A controller class that manages the installation process via command line, including argument parsing, validation, database setup, and configuration file creation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments to determine whether to display usage information or perform installation.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs the installation process: validates environment, connects to database, sets up schema, inserts initial data, and writes configuration files based on provided options.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Returns a string explaining how to use the command-line installer.
